pilsumlighthouse.name: Pilsum Lighthouse
pilsumlighthouse.slogan: A small striped tower on a big green dyke, forever Otto's home.
pilsumlighthouse.line: Lit for the first time on 1 October 1891, it guided ships through the Emshörn channel only until 1915, then found fame as comedian Otto Waalkes' home in his film.

greetsielmills.name: Greetsiel Twin Mills
greetsielmills.slogan: Two Dutch-style mills guarding a fishing village of crab cutters.
greetsielmills.line: The red mill dates back to 1706 and the other to 1856; both are Dutch-type windmills, one now a museum and the other a cafe.

schlossoldenburg.name: Oldenburg Palace
schlossoldenburg.slogan: From moated fortress to the counts' Renaissance home in the city.
schlossoldenburg.line: Count Anton Günther rebuilt the old moated castle between 1607 and 1616, and since 1921 it has been part of the state museum.

lappan.name: Lappan
lappan.slogan: The old hospital bell tower that outlived its town's great fire.
lappan.line: Built around 1467 as the bell tower of the Holy Spirit Hospital, it survived the 1676 fire and got its copper dome in 1709.

kunsthalleemden.name: Kunsthalle Emden
kunsthalleemden.slogan: Stern's founder gave his hometown a coastal home for Expressionists.
kunsthalleemden.line: Henri Nannen, founder of Stern magazine, brought about 650 works of his own when he founded the museum in his native Emden in 1986.
